review.images: Reviewed the official gallery and wide hero. Removed the narrower repeat of the hero elevation. The wide street view supplies the card. Interior selections show the living area and bedroom.
review.location: Matched Greenville’s exact point and reviewed physical brochure page 4. The original regional map and four driving times are included. The map marks Emaar South at community level.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed all 11 physical pages and all eight original two-storey drawings, with TH01 to TH04 in both Lyra and Zora. Checked each label, key plan and area panel visually and cross-checked all imperial totals against the independent extraction. All eight imperial totals reconcile to the sum of their components.

unavailable: Signed plot-specific areas and exact plot entrances were not verified.
